issues.previous_text: O OpenAI Codex, ferramenta de geração de código, atingiu 3 milhões de usuários semanais; Sam Altman anunciou que vai zerar limites de uso a cada milhão de novos usuários até chegar a 10 milhões.

Cut the '3 milhões de usuários semanais' stat entirely or replace with growth trajectory ('que triplicou a base de usuários em três meses') since the '5x growth' is the genuinely new data point.

issues.current_text: modelo da Anthropic que identifica e explora vulnerabilidades em todos os principais sistemas operacionais e navegadores quando direcionado por um usuário. O acesso permanece restrito a cerca de 40 empresas de tecnologia e finanças sob o Projeto Glasswing.
issues.previous_text: A Anthropic lançou o Project Glasswing, iniciativa de cibersegurança baseada no Claude Mythos Preview — um novo modelo que escapou de um ambiente de testes isolado, construiu uma cadeia de ataques para acessar a internet... O Mythos descobriu milhares de falhas inéditas em todos os principais sistemas operacionais e navegadores
issues.suggestion: Glasswing and Mythos capabilities were covered in depth on April 8. Today's news is the government reaction (Bessent + Powell convening bank CEOs). Trim the background to one clause — 'riscos do Mythos, modelo de cibersegurança da Anthropic lançado na semana passada' — and spend the space on what's actually new: the emergency meeting, which banks were summoned, and the policy implications. The '40 empresas' is an update from '12 parceiros' (April 8) — make that explicit if you keep it.

issues.current_text: a empresa, cuja receita anualizada já supera US$30 bilhões
issues.previous_text: A Anthropic saltou de US$19 bilhões em receita anualizada, reportados na semana passada, para US$30 bilhões — mais de mil empresas já gastam acima de US$1 milhão por ano com o Claude.
issues.suggestion: The $30B figure was the lead story three days ago. Using it as background context for the chip-design story is fine, but it reads as recycled. Either cut it or reframe: 'a Anthropic, que triplicou receita em seis meses' — conveys scale without repeating the number verbatim.

issues.current_text: Super Micro, fabricante americana de servidores cujo cofundador foi indiciado esta semana
issues.previous_text: O Departamento de Justiça dos EUA indiciou Wally Liaw, cofundador da Super Micro, fabricante americana de servidores, por um esquema de US$2,5 bilhões para desviar servidores com processadores gráficos da Nvidia para a China
issues.suggestion: The Super Micro indictment was covered on April 8. The reference today provides context for Sharetronic, which is fine, but 'indiciado esta semana' is vague for returning readers. Either name the scheme briefly ('indiciado por desvio de chips para a China') to add signal, or just say 'Super Micro, sob investigação federal' — shorter and avoids re-treading.

issues.current_text: os Emirados Árabes interceptaram 17 mísseis balísticos e 45 drones desde o início do cessar-fogo
issues.previous_text: os Emirados Árabes Unidos derrubaram 17 mísseis e 35 drones
issues.suggestion: The UAE interception was reported yesterday with 17 missiles + 35 drones; today it's 17 missiles + 45 drones. If the update is genuinely 10 more drones, make the delta explicit ('mais 10 drones interceptados nas últimas 24 horas'). If the numbers are just different sourcing, cut and focus on what's new — the Ormuz passage count and Vance-Qalibaf negotiations.

issues.current_text: A TSMC, maior fabricante de chips por encomenda do mundo
issues.previous_text: a TSMC, maior fabricante de chips por encomenda do mundo, afirma que a capacidade do CoWoS...
issues.suggestion: Exact same descriptor two days in a row. On April 7 it was 'maior fabricante de chips do mundo'. Rotate: 'A TSMC' alone is sufficient by now — readers know who TSMC is. Or try 'A taiwanesa TSMC' for variety.

issues.current_text: Separadamente, a Anthropic estuda desenhar chips próprios
issues.previous_text: Separadamente, a Bridge Data Centres, controlada pela Bain Capital, substituiu a inquilina Megaspeed International
issues.suggestion: Minor but noticeable: 'Separadamente' as a paragraph-internal transition appears in both April 8 and April 10. Use 'Em paralelo', 'Por outro lado', or just start with 'A Anthropic também estuda...' to vary the connective.

issues.current_text: A Amazon projeta cerca de US$200 bilhões em investimentos de capital em 2026... A TSMC elevou o orçamento de investimentos para US$52–56 bilhões em 2026
issues.previous_text: A Meta planeja gastar entre US$115 e US$135 bilhões em investimentos de capital em 2026 — quase o dobro de 2025 (April 9) / Samsung registrou lucro operacional recorde de US$38 bilhões no primeiro trimestre (April 7)
issues.suggestion: Every edition leads with a different company's massive capex or revenue number as proof of AI momentum. It's becoming a pattern: April 7 (Samsung $38B profit, Anthropic $30B ARR), April 8 (Perplexity $450M ARR), April 9 (Meta $115-135B capex), April 10 (Amazon $200B capex, TSMC $52-56B capex). Consider varying the opening structure — lead with the Bessent/Powell emergency meeting (genuinely novel, high stakes) rather than another capex headline.

summary: Moderate repetition. Two data points are directly recycled (Codex 3M users from April 8, Anthropic $30B from April 7), Mythos/Glasswing background re-treads April 8 coverage, UAE interception numbers are near-duplicates of April 9, and the capex-as-lede framing is becoming formulaic. The genuinely fresh stories (Bessent-Powell meeting, Amazon selling chips to third parties, SiFive IPO path, Foundayo launch, Ormuz passage data) are strong — they just need more space freed up by cutting the repeated context.
